content.title: Is prior experience in HR required for program enrollment?
content: This program is specifically crafted for mid-level professionals looking to advance their careers and expand their sectoral knowledge. It is intended for individuals with foundational industry experience.

content.title: What is the minimum system configuration required?
content: ## Minimum System Requirements for the Program:
- **Processor**: Any modern processor – Intel Core i3 (10th Gen or newer) / AMD Ryzen 3 (3000 series or newer) / Apple M1 or later

content.title: How much time does one need to spend on a regular basis?
content: In the Digital HR Leadership & People Analytics Program, you will work on real-world case studies and Capstone Projects to gain a better understanding of the practical applications of Digital HR Leadership concepts.

content.title: What is the duration of the program?
content: The duration of the program is 10 months.

content.title: How's the Executive Development Program in Strategic HR Leadership program different?
content: ### Three things that make this program world class
- **Progressive Learning Architecture:** XLRI's proprietary Progressive Learning Architecture ensures that irrespective of the background you are from, you will attain mastery in a step-by-step way.
- **Theory to Industry Learning Framework:** XLRI's Theory to Industry framework ensures that you are learning every HR Leadership concept in context of real-world industry problems.
- **Accredian Career Center:**  Aligned with our mission to cultivate the leaders of tomorrow, the Accredian Career Center empowers you to confidently launch your career.

content.title: Tell me more about Career Assistance?
content: You will have access to Accredian Career Support module. This module includes comprehensive career development sessions aimed at enhancing your job profile and helping you excel in your interviews.
